title: GMNS roadway selection (facility fragment)
description: A GMNS-native profile of the ProjectCard roadway selection. Mirrors roadway.selection.select_links + select_segment, keyed by GMNS-native link_id / node_id. Convert to ProjectCard's model_link_id / model_node_id via gmnspy.select.emit.to_projectcard.

link_id.description: Ordered GMNS link_id values along the facility.
